name: behavior-modeling-benchmark
description: A dataset and benchmark suite for modeling human/agent behavior across one or more tasks, measuring a model's ability to predict next actions, classify behavioral intents, or reproduce observed trajectories. It is intended to benchmark sequence- and behavior-prediction methods (e.g., behavior cloning, trajectory forecasting) across the provided scenarios and modalities. The benchmark focuses on predictive fidelity and generalization of learned behavior patterns.
evaluation_method: task-dependent metrics such as accuracy / F1 for classification and RMSE or displacement error for trajectory/sequence prediction
reputation: An emerging academic benchmark from Tsinghua FIB Lab with growing interest in behavior prediction research but not yet widespread adoption.
